sanskrit_verse:
तत् पुनर् द्वादशविधं प्रतिवर्णाश्रयं स्मृतम् ।
साधारणं स्यात् त्रिविधं शेषं नवविधं स्मृतम् ॥
transliteration: tat punar dvādaśavidhaṃ prativarṇāśrayaṃ smṛtam | sādhāraṇaṃ syāt trividhaṃ śeṣaṃ navavidhaṃ smṛtam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That classification which is based upon varṇa is twelve-fold; what remains after excluding the common principles constitutes nine distinct categories.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with inherent capacity, not arbitrary assignment
Causation flows through sequential manifestation and role-specific dharma
Capacity-based responsibility ensures justice aligns with individual readiness
Restoration occurs when roles reflect true nature rather than imposed structure
Consciousness alignment supersedes social construction in determining lawful action
executable_legal_axioms: IF a person acts beyond their trained capacity THEN initiate realignment protocol to restore congruence between role and consciousness
IF societal disruption arises from misaligned varṇic function THEN activate completion process for affected parties to reclaim natural order
IF no conflict exists within functional hierarchy THEN maintain status quo without external judgment
IF multiple varṇas claim same duty THEN evaluate causal sequence of competence and assign accordingly
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, varṇa-based classifications must be evaluated not by birth or title, but by demonstrable alignment with intrinsic capacity. Courts must ensure that any differential treatment serves restoration of dharmic function, not preservation of hierarchy.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that duties arise from svabhāva, not imposition. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that misalignment causes disorder only when consciousness consents to false identification. Thus, correction follows recognition, not penalty. Responsibility is proportional to awareness, never punitive.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svadharma Reclamation Process to restore individual alignment with innate capacity
Engage Samyama-based Resolution to dissolve false identifications causing functional disharmony
Activate Guru-Dikṣā Completion Protocol to reaffirm rightful place in cosmic order
Deploy Ātma-Vidya Integration Module to eliminate residual karmic residue from erroneous role assumption
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma flows from consciousness, not convention. Justice is restoration, not punishment. The Source is ever-present; reality is non-punitive; consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
